items.question: Is Invoiceo completely free?
items.answer:
Yes — Invoiceo is **100% free**. No subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no premium tiers.

It is open source under the **MIT License** and is based on **Invoiso** by ANOOP P. The source code is at https://github.com/Maddy-1303/invoiceo.

items.question: Does Invoiceo work without an internet connection?
items.answer: Absolutely. Invoiceo works **entirely offline** — all your data (customers, products, invoices) is stored right on your device. No internet connection is needed at any point.

items.question: Which operating systems does Invoiceo support?
items.answer: Invoiceo runs on **Windows**, **Linux**, and **macOS**. Download it from https://invoiceo.in/download.html — **.exe** for Windows, **.dmg** for macOS, and **.deb** or **AppImage** for Linux.

items.question: Do I need to create an account to use Invoiceo?
items.answer: No account needed. Invoiceo requires **no registration**, no email address, and no sign-up of any kind — install it and start creating invoices right away.

items.question: Is my business data safe with Invoiceo?
items.answer:
Your data **never leaves your device**. Invoiceo stores everything in a local SQLite database — no cloud sync, no remote servers.

You're in full control, and the built-in **backup** feature keeps your data safe and portable.

items.question: How do I back up my invoice data?
items.answer:
Go to **Settings → Backup**.

Create a backup file and save it anywhere on your computer. You can restore it any time from the same screen — no internet or cloud account needed.

items.question: Can I move my data to another computer?
items.answer:
Yes. Use the **Backup** feature to export your database file, copy it to the new machine, install Invoiceo there, and restore the backup from Settings.

All your customers, products, and invoices transfer completely.

items.question: Can I export invoices as PDF?
items.answer:
Yes. Generate professional PDF invoices with a single click.

Go to **Settings → PDF Settings** to choose a template — such as **Classic**, **Modern**, **Minimal**, **Executive**, **Compact**, **Grid Classic**, or **Thermal** for receipt printers (the list depends on the page size) — and add your own logo and branding.

items.question: Does Invoiceo support multiple currencies?
items.answer: Yes. Invoiceo supports **150+ currencies**, including **INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SGD, AUD, CAD**, and **JPY**. Set your preferred currency in **Settings → Invoice Settings**.

items.question: Does Invoiceo support multiple languages?
items.answer:
Yes. The app is available in **English, Tamil, Hindi, Nepali, Tibetan, French, Spanish**, and **Chinese (Simplified)** — English is the default. An admin can change the language in **Settings → Company Info**.

You can also set a local-language **alias name** for each product and customer, which shows on invoice PDFs.

items.question: Can I create quotations as well as invoices?
items.answer:
Yes. When creating a document, choose either **Invoice** or **Quotation** as the type.

Both generate professional PDFs and are tracked separately in the list with color-coded badges.

items.question: Can I duplicate or clone an existing invoice?
items.answer:
Yes. Every invoice has a **Duplicate** button.

Click it, choose Invoice or Quotation, and a new document opens pre-filled with the same customer, products, tax settings, and notes — with a fresh ID and today's date. Great for repeat or recurring work.

items.question: How do I add my company logo to an invoice?
items.answer:
Go to **Settings → Company Info**, click the logo area, and choose a **PNG or JPG** image (max 1080 × 1080 px and 2 MB).

Your logo then appears automatically on every generated PDF invoice.

items.question: Can I export invoice data to CSV or Excel?
items.answer:
Yes. The **Invoice Management** screen has an **Export CSV** button in the toolbar for all your invoices, plus a **bulk export** option for just the ones you select.

The CSV opens fine in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app.

items.question: Does Invoiceo support dark mode?
items.answer:
Yes, **dark mode** is available in beta. Go to **Settings → Company Info** and toggle it on to switch the dashboard, login screen, and core modules to a dark theme.

It's still being polished, so let us know if anything looks off.

items.question: Can I manage multiple companies or businesses in Invoiceo?
items.answer:
Yes. Go to **Settings → Companies**, or tap the company name at the top of the sidebar, to create, switch between, rename, or delete companies.

Each company has its own completely separate database — invoices, customers, products, settings, and backups never mix between companies.

items.question: Why do I have to log in again after switching companies?
items.answer:
Switching companies changes which database is loaded, so Invoiceo logs you out and returns to the Login screen to make sure you sign in with the right account for that company.

This also prevents data (invoices, products) that's already loaded in memory from one company leaking into the other.

items.question: Does Invoiceo support GST invoicing?
items.answer: Yes. Invoiceo supports **GST-ready invoices** — GSTIN fields for your company and customers, an HSN code per product, and tax rates set globally or per item. Built for Indian businesses filing GST returns.

items.question: Can I add a UPI QR code to my invoice?
items.answer:
Yes. Go to **Settings → Company Info → Payment Settings**, enter your **UPI ID** (e.g. yourname@bank), and turn on the QR toggle.

Invoiceo then embeds a scannable UPI QR code in every PDF, so customers can pay instantly via GPay, PhonePe, or Paytm.

items.question: Which UPI apps work with the Invoiceo QR code?
items.answer: The QR code uses the standard **upi://pay** link format, supported by all major UPI apps — **Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay**, and any other UPI-enabled banking app.

items.question: Is Invoiceo available as a portable version?
items.answer:
On **Linux** you can choose the **.deb** installer or the portable **AppImage** — no installation needed: download the file, mark it executable, and run it.

**Windows** uses a standard installer (.exe) and **macOS** a .dmg. All downloads are at https://invoiceo.in/download.html.

items.question: Where is my data stored on disk?
items.answer:
Your database lives in your OS's app-data folder:

**Windows:** %AppData%\Invoiceo\Invoiceo\

**macOS:** ~/Library/Containers/com.invoiceo.app/Data/Library/Application Support/com.invoiceo.app/

**Linux:** ~/.local/share/com.invoiceo.app/

To copy or move your data, use **Settings → Backup** instead of copying these files by hand.

items.question: What do I do if I forgot my password?
items.answer: Use the built-in self-service reset — no reinstalling and no losing your invoices, customers, or data. Click "Forgot password?" on the login screen, then send support the **Installation ID** shown there together with **your username**. Support will send back a **one-time response code** that works only for that username; enter your username and the code in the app, set a new password, and you're back in.

items.question: Is the source code available?
items.answer:
Yes. Invoiceo is **open source** under the **MIT License**. It is based on **Invoiso**, an open-source app by ANOOP P, also released under the MIT License.

The source code is at https://github.com/Maddy-1303/invoiceo — bug reports and feature requests are welcome there.

items.question: Is Invoiceo a free alternative to Vyapar?
items.answer:
Yes. Invoiceo is a free, open-source alternative to **Vyapar** for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Unlike Vyapar, Invoiceo needs **no account or phone signup**, is completely free with **no paid tier**, and is open source under the MIT License (based on **Invoiso** by ANOOP P; source at https://github.com/Maddy-1303/invoiceo). Both apps support offline billing and GST-ready invoices with UPI QR codes — but Invoiceo also runs on **Linux and macOS**, which Vyapar doesn't.

items.question: Can I use Invoiceo as free GST billing software for my business in India?
items.answer:
Yes. Invoiceo works well as **free GST billing software** for Indian businesses — GSTIN fields, HSN codes, **CGST/SGST/IGST** tax rates, and UPI QR payments on PDFs, all generated entirely offline.

No subscription, no account, no internet required.

items.question: Which types of businesses in India use Invoiceo?
items.answer:
All kinds — **kirana shops, retailers, hardware stores, textile sellers, traders, wholesalers**, service businesses, repair shops, freelancers, consultants, and agencies.

If you need offline GST billing, PDF invoices, and payment tracking without a subscription, Invoiceo fits.
